_about: GENERATED by scripts/build-cup-ledger.mts — do not edit by hand. The denominator of the filling phase: what every part of each kind is asked. tests/cupLedger.test.ts fails when the profile no longer matches.

gap_states.filled: the part holds a current fact under the key (facts.superseded_by IS NULL, not retracted)
gap_states.not-parsed: a spec-bearing document linked to the part (doc_parts) carries a label that maps to the key, and no fact was stored
gap_states.not-held: no spec-bearing document is linked to the part at all — an acquisition gap, not a parsing one
gap_states.not-published: a gap_confirmed fact: every capable source was checked and none states it

totals._slots_note: at_nothing_known = parts × (required + pending) with only the kind known; stored = the live denominator (completeness.required_total), smaller wherever an answered gate has closed a pending question

fallback._about: TWO AXES. `asked_nothing` = the kind's question set is empty (a profile property, and the phase-1 number). `unresolved_kind` = the kind name means the axis could not say (a classifier property). They are independent: a named kind can be asked nothing, and an unresolved kind can be asked a cup. `facts3` and `device_noun` are the two detectors for a real product swallowed by either: a part holding three or more facts of its own, and a part whose NAME names a whole box. tests/cupLedger.test.ts asserts both axes.
